latestVersion.changelog:
- Changed all API and management endpoints from *.maton.ai/gateway.maton.ai/ctrl.maton.ai to api.maton.ai.
- Updated Quick Start and code examples to use the new base URL: https://api.maton.ai.
- Updated connection management (list/create/get/delete) to use https://api.maton.ai endpoint.
- Added a "Security & Permissions" section emphasizing user approval for write operations.
- LICENSE.txt file was removed.
- Documentation clarifies Maton now proxies requests (not "gateway"), and standardizes connection header usage.
